ModMetaData.name: AutomaticOutfitManager
ModMetaData.author: tekmojo
ModMetaData.description: Create area-based outfit and personal protective equipment (PPE) rules. Pawns equip required gear before qualifying work, use a configurable follow-up task buffer, return through an optional locker room, and restore their exact saved clothing. Includes live worker status, pause/resume controls, hauling and wandering permissions, pawn-category access, nested work areas, locker restocking, managed-outfit storage filters, saved-owner protection, and generic support for vanilla or modded apparel.
